File: README.md

Add instructions for setting S3_ENDPOINT in the local setup steps so that local MinIO uploads do not fail with getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND trying to reach AWS S3.
args.title: Document S3_ENDPOINT in local setup instructions for MinIO

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The README.md setup instructions omit S3_ENDPOINT, causing local MinIO uploads to fail with getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND.
